answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. This creates a hard economic horizon where the cost of identity fabrication scales linearly with capital, making a massive attack prohibitively expensive. Even a zephyr of fraudulent traffic cannot bypass this barrier, as each unique identity demands a sacrifice of value. Like the impenetrable density of onyx, this financial commitment anchors the network against malicious exploitation.
